mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (id, user_id, post_type, title, content, images, status, like_count, comment_count, favorite_count, is_top, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{userId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{postType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{favoriteCount}, #{isTop}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
